h: The Third Meal Reveals the Holiness That Yearning Preserves

p: and so in the morning we say,
but in the song for the third meal
we do not invite at all,
Also, at night and in the morning
we say the song before the meal,
we say it after the meal.
"among the watchers and all the winged ones";
which is not so in the morning and at night.
And even though at night we say,
for on Shabbos there is the union
of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah;
and it is called the meal of the King,
even though it is the meal
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
according to what is written in the holy Zohar
and in a place where are found
the praise is only to the male," etc.
And on Shabbos Yisrael are called a bride,
is like the Mikdash in place;
which was founded at the building of the House,
And it says in the Gemara (Chagigah 14b):
who gather and come to see
the festivities of a groom and bride," etc.;
for it is customary for people to gather there,
when the groom and bride eat
So here too the angels come
to see the festivities of groom and bride,
and before the meal we dismiss them
and say, "Let us invite her now,"
the meal of the Field of Apples,
And so in the morning we say,
is like the eating of the offerings,
which is called "My bread for My fire-offerings" (Bamidbar 28:2),
and all the offerings are offered
only to the Name Havayah, blessed be He;
the intellect hidden from all thought,
and there is only a revelation
of the feeling of the light in the heart;
and so we say "the meal of the King,"
for the meal is the meal of Atika.
which is the meal of Ze'ir Anpin,
there is no need to invite again
and said that it is the meal of the King;
"Members of the palace who yearn," etc.,
"may they be here at this table,"
is at the time of the meal,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (יִתְרוֹ, חֵלֶק ב פח, א)
as written in the holy Zohar (Yisro, II 88a):
fills the head of Ze'ir Anpin, etc.,
then the holiness shines to him;
so how would they know the times?
there is a dwelling of holiness,
an impression of holiness remains there
And here, since it is before Birkas HaMazon,
all the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin;
and the main thing depends on
"the members of the palace who yearn."
that is, whoever has kept the three meals,
who are called members of the King's palace,
as written in the holy Zohar
that is, they have a desire for this,
for the Holy One, blessed be He,
wants from us the will of the heart,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (שְׁלַח, חֵלֶק ג קס, א)
as written in the holy Zohar (Shelach, III 160a):
with the will of the heart
toward the Holy One, blessed be He,
לָא בָּעֵי מִינַּן אֶלָּא לִבָּא וְכוּלֵּי
He wants from us nothing but the heart," etc.
And since it is already after the meal,
just as people gather to see
the festivities of a groom and bride,
to see the radiance of Ze'ir Anpin;
among the watchers and all the winged ones."

paragraphs.text: Source: Chagigah 14b — “… פתח רבי יהושע ודרש. ואותו היום תקופת תמוז היה. נתקשרו שמים בעבים ונראה כמין קשת בענן, והיו מלאכי השרת מתקבצין ובאין לשמוע, כבני אדם שמתקבצין ובאין לראות במזמוטי חתן וכלה.” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 225) — “The Gemara relates: And when these matters, this story involving his colleague Rabbi Elazar ben Arakh, were recounted before Rabbi Yehoshua, he was walking along the way with Rabbi Yosei the Priest. They said: We too shall expound the Design …”

paragraphs.text: Source: Sanhedrin 106b — “ורב יהודה שליף מסאני ואתי מטרא, ואנן צוחינן וליכא דמשגח בן. אלא הקדוש ברוך הוא ליבא בעי, דכתיב: ״וה׳ יראה ללבב״.” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 223) — “But nevertheless, when Rav Yehuda would remove one of his shoes the rain would immediately fall, whereas we cry out and no one notices us. Rather, the Holy One, Blessed be He, seeks the heart, and the barometer of greatness …”
